method: Each map is a relief image plus a "flood level" grid. The flood level of a cell is the lowest lake level at which water from the lake reaches that cell (a priority flood from a seed in the lake). The page fills every cell whose flood level is at or below the chosen lake level, so closed hollows above the lake stay dry.
